name: diagram-skills
description: Professional diagram drawing skills: baoyu-diagram generates polished, editable, self-contained SVG for 技术路线图 (roadmaps/timelines), 路径图 (flowcharts/data flows), 框架图 (architecture/structural diagrams), sequence diagrams, mind maps and state machines, with a complete design system; academic-diagram-style overlays a publication-grade 科研风格 (white background, colorblind-safe Okabe-Ito palette, journal typography) for papers and reports; image2-diagram generates raster figures via OpenAI GPT Image 2 (needs OPENAI_API_KEY); frontend-design is Anthropic's official aesthetic-calibration skill against templated-looking output.

author.name: Jim Liu (baoyu-diagram) & Anthropic (frontend-design), bundled by xixi
